messages:
Mia (Support): Hey team, customer reported a sudden credits spike overnight (~25x). They say nothing changed on their side except our trial promo was active. Can we triage? :confused:
Raj (SRE): Got it — which endpoints were showing activity? Logs?
Mia (Support): They shared billing ledger showing most usage against embeddings and a rerank pipeline. We requested request IDs, here's one: req_01FZ2XY.
Ellie (ML Eng): Quick hypothesis: background ingestion job re-sent batches after transient errors (500/502) and didn't back off. That could blow through credits fast on embeddings.
Mia (Support): Customer says they saw intermittent 502s from our API between 02:15–02:42 UTC. After that their worker retried many times.
support-bot: Deploy finished: infra/proxy 2026-03-09T01:52:12Z (no known regressions).
Raj (SRE): Poking logs for req_01FZ2XY... pulling from prod-access logs now.
Raj (SRE): Paste of relevant logs (redacted):
```
[2026-03-10T02:16:03Z] req_01FZ2XY embeddings POST 200 150ms
[2026-03-10T02:16:08Z] req_01FZ2XZ embeddings POST 502 22ms
[2026-03-10T02:16:10Z] worker/ingest retry batch_id=bb-412 attempts=1
[2026-03-10T02:16:13Z] req_01FZ2XZ embeddings POST 200 120ms
[2026-03-10T02:17:00Z] req_01FZ2XY rerank POST 502 18ms
[2026-03-10T02:17:03Z] worker/ingest retry batch_id=bb-412 attempts=2
[2026-03-10T02:17:05Z] req_01FZ2XY rerank POST 502 20ms
[2026-03-10T02:17:08Z] worker/ingest retry batch_id=bb-412 attempts=3
[2026-03-10T02:17:12Z] req_01FZ2XY rerank POST 200 90ms
[2026-03-10T02:18:00Z] worker/ingest retry batch_id=bb-412 attempts=4
```
Mia (Support): So the client retried multiple times even after successful 200s. Looks like they didn't honor idempotency or backoff.
Ellie (ML Eng): The rerank flow hits embeddings + reranker: two billable calls per item. Retries multiply that. Also check whether our responses for 502 included a retry-after header — I think for 502 we don't set Retry-After currently.
Raj (SRE): Confirmed: proxy returns 502 without Retry-After on upstream failures. We intentionally avoid Retry-After for 502 because it's not always helpful, but that means clients might retry aggressively.
Mia (Support): Customer asked if we can refund the unexpected credits (they're on a trial/promo). Any precedent?
Raj (SRE): From SRE side we can produce a usage audit (per-request). If it's clearly client-side aggressive retries after transient errors, we can recommend credit adjustment but need approval from billing.
Ellie (ML Eng): Short-term mitigation: add idempotency guidance to docs and set a soft server-side rate limit for the embeddings and rerank endpoints for trial accounts to prevent runaway loops. Long-term: add Retry-After for 5xx where feasible, and mark certain retried requests as potential duplicates when they arrive within a small time window.
Mia (Support): I told the customer we can escalate for credits review and asked for a single CSV of request ids and timestamps. They uploaded a CSV with ~3.2k request ids over 30 minutes.
Raj (SRE): I ran a quick dedupe across their request ids — about 62% look duplicated within a 10s window. That's consistent with a retry storm.
support-bot: Billing case created: #BILL-5842 by Mia (Support).
Mia (Support): Tagging Billing: @billing-team — please review BILL-5842. Summary: trial account hit large credit usage due to background ingestion retried on intermittent 502s. Recommend partial credit refund and guidance doc for idempotency.
Ellie (ML Eng): For the tech fix, I'll file an RFC for: 1) send Retry-After on transient upstream 5xx when we detect overload 2) server-side duplicate suppression heuristic keyed on user+batch_id+payload-hash for 30s window 3) add client best-practices snippet in docs (exponential backoff + idempotency keys).
Raj (SRE): Short-term fix I can push tonight: add a lightweight 429-based soft-throttle for trial orgs hitting embeddings/rerank with burst > X req/min, and return `X-RateLimit-Reset` header. That should cut down hammer retries.
Mia (Support): Billing asked for exact credits to refund. Raj do you have an estimate?
Raj (SRE): After dedupe, estimated billable calls = 3.2k unique * 2 calls/item = ~6.4k billable requests. Their nominal per-embedding credit is 0.0005 credit/unit (example). I'll hand off precise token/credit calc to Billing with raw logs.
Mia (Support): Customer accepted a partial refund pending Billing approval. They also agreed to pause their ingestion until we push the soft-throttle.
Ellie (ML Eng): Note for the record: rerank endpoint internally makes two separate model calls. If we later switch to a fused rerank pipeline it can halve billing surface for such jobs. Adding to roadmap.
Raj (SRE): Action items: 1) Billing: review BILL-5842 and process credit adjustment 2) SRE: deploy soft-throttle for trial orgs (ETA: tonight) 3) ML Eng: RFC for idempotency/Retry-After (ETA: EOW) 4) Support: follow up with customer once billing done.
Mia (Support): I'll update the customer thread and close out once billing confirms. Thanks all :pray:
Ellie (ML Eng): Adding a short support KB blurb for "Unexpected credits from background jobs" after we finalize wording.
Mia (Support): Closing note: customer appreciated quick triage. Leaving thread open until credits resolved.
